description: Scrolls the page. Use it to see the rest of a page: annotate_interactive and the screenshots only cover what is on screen, and its "coverage" field says how much of the page that is. Scroll, then capture again. This moves the camera, not the hands: it cannot click, type or navigate.

element.description: A number from the most recent annotate_interactive on this tab. Easier and safer than retyping a selector.

selector.description: Scroll until this element is centred.

to.description: "next" and "previous" move by about one screen.

y.description: An absolute scroll position in CSS pixels.

name: scroll_to
title: Move the viewport
